summary: Bone Biologics Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events, announcing the postponement of its 2026 annual meeting from August 11 to September 28, 2026, to allow additional time for a new proposal to be included in the proxy materials. The new record date is August 6, 2026, and the deadline for stockholder submissions is July 26, 2026. This is a routine scheduling change without any special-situation event such as M&A, activism, or restructuring. The filing includes no deal terms or strategic triggers.
